description: Make the credit claims a person's learning supports, from their package. The answer names its path in `path`. The GoldSeam path (`goldseam`): when the package holds a GoldSeam Selfie (make_my_selfie, add_to_my_selfie, respond_to_my_statements) with at least one statement the person affirmed, even beside a document Selfie, each affirmed statement is one claim in the person's own words, with the words it came from and its KSA Dictionary identifiers. Nothing is drafted, no AI is called and no confidence number is assigned; a statement they reject or remove in their Selfie is no longer a claim. The OpenAI path (`openai`): a package holding only a document Selfie (after my_selfie_ksa_view) gets drafted claims, each quoting the document it rests on. They are drafts for the person to keep, affirm or decline (set each claim's confidence to ratified, affirmed or declined in the package); the AI never affirms a claim. Give the school they are thinking of as `school` so its catalog is made ready for suggest_credit_for_my_learning. Nothing is stored: the answer returns the package for the agent to keep.

aspiration.description: Optional: what the person is aiming for

package.description: The goldribbon_package_v1 object an earlier GoldRibbon answer returned. Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

school.description: Optional: the school they are thinking of, a name or IPEDS UNITID; its catalog is made ready for the suggestions

name: draft_my_claims

claims.description: The claims made by this call, each with summary, source_fragment, kind, evidence_tier and recommendation_mode. On the GoldSeam path one per affirmed statement, with statement_id, identifiers and confidence affirmed, and no confidence_floor; on the OpenAI path drafted, with confidence drafted

counts.description: affirmed_statements on the GoldSeam path; drafted, answered_kept on the OpenAI path

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package, with this service's part filled

path.description: The path this answer took: goldseam (the GoldSeam Selfie's affirmed statements, no AI call) or openai (the document Selfie)

title: Draft My Claims
